title: Thin Mint Crackers
description: This recipe uses buttery round Ritz crackers, semisweet chocolate, and peppermint extract to make delicious mint-chocolate treats.
ingredients: 1 pound bittersweet chocolate, broken into small pieces

steps.text: Place chocolate in the top of a double boiler over just barely simmering water. Stir frequently, scraping down the sides with a rubber spatula, until chocolate is melted, 15 to 20 minutes. Do not get any water into the chocolate.
While the chocolate is melting, line two baking sheets with parchment paper and set in the freezer to chill.
Remove melted chocolate from the stove and stir in peppermint extract.
Dip crackers into melted chocolate and then place on the cold, prepared baking sheets. Set the baking sheets in the refrigerator until chocolate sets, about 5 minutes.
Package cookies in candy cups if desired. Store at room temperature or in a cool, dry place away from any odors.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make thin mint crackers using melted chocolate and buttery crackers. There are only a few steps to this recipe, starting with chilling the baking pan beforehand. With a sauce pan, melt the chocolate over the stove. Once melted and taken off the stove, mix in peppermint extract to give it the minty taste. Coat the crackers in the chocolate and refrigerate them on the baking pan until the chocolate sets. It’ll satisfy your sweet tooth in under 30 minutes!
